## Description {#details}

<p>Tracks register operand latency in cycles.</p>


<p>A read may be dependent on more than one write. This occurs when some writes only partially update the register associated to this read.</p>


<p>Definition at line 326 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mca/instruction-h">Instruction.h</a>.</p>
